statements.subject: server
statements.description: Implementations MUST ensure appropriate scope limitation based on the authenticated caller's authorization boundaries.
actions: Ensure appropriate scope limitation based on the authenticated caller's authorization boundaries for all operations that access or list tasks and other resources

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Servers MUST implement authorization checks on every A2A Protocol Operations request
actions: Implement authorization checks on every A2A Protocol Operations request

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Implementations MUST scope results to the caller's authorized access boundaries as defined by the agent's authorization model
actions: Scope results to the caller's authorized access boundaries as defined by the agent's authorization model

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Even when contextId or other filter parameters are not specified in requests, implementations MUST scope results to the caller's authorized access boundaries
actions: Scope results to the caller's authorized access boundaries even when contextId or other filter parameters are absent from the request

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Authorization models are agent-defined and MAY be based on:
actions: Base authorization model on user identity, organizational roles or groups, project or workspace membership, organizational or tenant boundaries, or custom authorization logic

statements.subject: server
statements.description: List Tasks: MUST only return tasks visible to the authenticated client according to the agent's authorization model
actions: Return only tasks visible to the authenticated client according to the agent's authorization model in response to List Tasks operations

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Get Task: MUST verify the authenticated client has access to the requested task according to the agent's authorization model
actions: Verify the authenticated client has access to the requested task according to the agent's authorization model before returning task data

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Task-related operations (Cancel, Subscribe, Push Notification Config): MUST verify the client has appropriate access rights according to the agent's authorization model
actions: Verify the client has appropriate access rights according to the agent's authorization model before executing Cancel, Subscribe, or Push Notification Config operations

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Authorization checks MUST occur before any database queries or operations that could leak information about the existence of resources outside the caller's authorization scope
actions: Perform authorization checks before any database queries or operations that could leak information about the existence of resources outside the caller's authorization scope

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Agents SHOULD document their authorization model and access control policies
actions: Document the agent's access control policies
